'''2001 Ohio State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Ohio in 2001.<ref name="dt-15558">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15558 OHIO Runner Up Dark Deck------------------------], DeckTech (Nate "number 1" Meeker, 24 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15558/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15558/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 24 April)
* '''Site:''' Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' —

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

About fifty players entered. Meeker finished runner-up; his Dark deck went 3–0 and he ended at 12 (+73).<ref name="dt-15558" /> His Light deck also went 3–0, beating Jamie Abel and two players rated over 1900.<ref name="dt-15581" /> Eier's Dark deck, built the night before, went 3–0 with wins of 14, 18 and 19.<ref name="dt-15562" /> Sykes's Dark deck won all three of its games, by 21, 23 and 27; he signed as the 7th-place finisher and names Matt Scott as 5th with a Quiet Mining Colony deck.<ref name="dt-15584" /> Veasey finished 6th with a Dark ISB Operations deck; its only two losses were to Jamie Abel.<ref name="dt-15556" /> Booker's Dark deck went 3–0 against Watch Your Step, Hidden Base mains and Echo Base Operations; he wrote that timed-out games kept him from 3rd.<ref name="dt-15587" />
